worldcombat.skill.pound.summary: A quick, wide swat in front of you: the quick form has no wind-up while the heavy form spends one beat raising the limb; whatever stands in the fan takes the hit and is nudged aside. The cheapest move of the family - shortest cooldown, and it can catch several targets packed side by side, at the cost of the lowest single hit and a very shallow fan. Pick any target, or just aim a direction and swat empty air; a solid wall blocks the fan.
worldcombat.skill.pound.use.1: Catch several targets packed together in one swat
worldcombat.skill.pound.use.2: Toss one in between other moves
worldcombat.skill.pound.description.0: Sweeps a %2$s degree fan reaching %3$s blocks; every non-ally inside takes about %1$s physical damage.
worldcombat.skill.pound.description.1: A struck target is pushed about %1$s blocks along the swat.
worldcombat.skill.pound.description.aim: Free aim: pick an any-relation entity, or just give a direction or world point and swat empty air; the whole fan still sweeps with no target, and a solid wall keeps it from reaching behind.
worldcombat.skill.pound.heavy.on: Heavy form: a harder swat with a wider fan that pushes the target a step, but it gains a preparation and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.pound.heavy.off: Quick form: instant, with the shortest recovery and cooldown and always ready, but the lowest single hit and almost no push.
worldcombat.skill.pound.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; a %2$s s wind-up, costing %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.pound.growth.0: At level %1$s, Pound power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.pound.growth.1: At level %1$s, Pound power rises to %2$s and the fan opens to %3$s degrees.
worldcombat.skill.pound.preference.heavy: On: a harder swat with a wider fan that pushes the target a step, but with a preparation and a longer cooldown. Off (quick form): instant, shortest cooldown, always ready, but the lowest single hit and almost no push.
worldcombat.skill.pound.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of swatting. The move only reaches in front of the body, so larger values mostly invite whiffs while chasing.
worldcombat.skill.pound.preference.ai.sw: On: strongly prefers this swat when two or more enemies stand inside the fan. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
